title: Vehicle Fire Sparks Grass Fire in Hay Field Near Longhorn Lane - NewsBreak
text:
9 hours ago A vehicle fire in a hay field near Longhorn Lane drew a response from multiple fire agencies Tuesday evening after reports of an explosion and a growing grass fire. Central Douglas Fire & Rescue was dispatched at 4:43 p.m. on June 2 after callers reported a vehicle on fire in a hay field. Early information indicated the fire had spread to about one-quarter acre, with a home nearby, though the flames were not reported to be moving toward the structure at the time. Read full article
